quest.title: A Very Festive Problem
quest.description: Bubu Pharmacy's Herbalist Gui is racking his brains about something...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x30, Mora x20000, Festive Fever x100

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: Argh, I need to take a breather...

dialogues.speaker: Herbalist Gui
dialogues.text: So I'm afraid it's all up to you for now, Traveler.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Got it.

dialogues.speaker: Herbalist Gui
dialogues.text: Thank you. Here's the medicine. Please get them to Guanhai and Zhihua as quickly as you can.

talks.objective: Deliver medicine to the people in the area

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: Ugh, I must've eaten something that didn't agree with me...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Here's some medicine from Herbalist Gui...

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: Oh, thank you. This is that stomach medicine I asked him for, isn't it? I think I might be getting indigestion... my stomach's feeling mighty terrible right now.

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: I was just strolling through the city streets, having a bite to eat here and there, and before I knew it, I'd overeaten ...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What did you eat...?

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: Hmm, fried rice, raw fish, some fruit, lots and lots of shrimp... Ah yes, and some excellent wine!

response.speaker: Zhihua
response.text: Well, that's what medicine is for, isn't it? Think about it — what's the point of a festival if you can't eat whatever you like?

response.speaker: Zhihua
response.text: Thanks for bringing the medicine, either way. I should probably take this opportunity to rest as well.

choices.text: You shouldn't overindulge, even during a festival.

talks.objective: Deliver medicine to the people in the area

dialogues.speaker: Guanhai
dialogues.text: Ow, ow, ow... It hurts... Excuse me? D—Did you want something?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Here's some medicine from Herbalist Gui...

dialogues.speaker: Guanhai
dialogues.text: Wow, thanks! Just what I ordered... Fast turnaround time, I must say.

dialogues.speaker: Guanhai
dialogues.text: Ahh, I feel better already. Must've caught a chill last night from the sea breeze, I'll wager...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: No indigestion for you?

dialogues.speaker: Guanhai
dialogues.text: Hah, indigestion? Me? I'll have you know that I have an iron stomach — why, I ate three grilled fish in one sitting for my last meal!

dialogues.speaker: Guanhai
dialogues.text: Even now, not one of my friends can match my prowess at eating and drinking.

dialogues.speaker: Guanhai
dialogues.text: Alright, enough about that. I'd better finish this medicine real quick — I've got a drinking session to get to.

choices.text: Make sure to take care of yourself.

response.speaker: Guanhai
response.text: Hahaha, oh, don't worry about me. I'm not some old fogey!

response.speaker: Guanhai
response.text: Still, thanks for the concern. I'll be careful.

choices.text: Don't wait until your health is ruined.

dialogues.speaker: Herbalist Gui
dialogues.text: Ah, it's you. Have you finished that Xiao Lantern?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Here it is.

dialogues.speaker: Herbalist Gui
dialogues.text: Thank you ever so much.

dialogues.speaker: Herbalist Gui
dialogues.text: This lantern is both well-shaped and sturdy. Heh, my craftsmanship pales in comparison to yours...

dialogues.speaker: Herbalist Gui
dialogues.text: In that case, we'll release this lantern later at night. I know a good spot.

dialogues.speaker: Herbalist Gui
dialogues.text: In the meantime, I need to think of what I should wish for...

dialogues.speaker: Herbalist Gui
dialogues.text: Thanks for your help. Have all the medicines been delivered?

choices.text: I don't think any of them learned their lesson...

response.speaker: Herbalist Gui
response.text: Well, there's not much we can do about that. Stomach problems won't go away unless you watch your lifestyle. The best we can do is treat the symptoms whenever they show up.

response.speaker: Herbalist Gui
response.text: But I suppose that I can rest easy for now, at least...

response.speaker: Herbalist Gui
response.text: Oh... We don't generally release lanterns. The whole point of Xiao Lanterns is to make a wish, right? Well... What sort of wish would Bubu Pharmacy even make?

response.speaker: Herbalist Gui
response.text: Other businesses may wish for their business to thrive and boom, but a pharmacy is in the business of curing disease and saving lives... we can't exactly wish for more sick people, can we?

choices.text: You've got a good heart, Gui.

response.speaker: Herbalist Gui
response.text: Heh... Well, on a more personal level, of course I'd love to join in. I mean, it is a festival...

response.speaker: Herbalist Gui
response.text: But I haven't made much headway in constructing a Xiao Lantern. These last few days have been much too busy...

response.speaker: Herbalist Gui
response.text: I can only steal a few moments during my breaks to work on it, and even then I'm sure the Lantern Rite will be over by the time I finish...

response.speaker: Herbalist Gui
response.text: W—Will you really? Wow, thank you so much!

choices.text: You're likely to hear from them again soon...

talks.objective: Make a Xiao Lantern for Herbalist Gui

dialogues.speaker: Herbalist Gui
dialogues.text: As for my wish... I ultimately wished for everyone in Liyue to be healthy and well.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And as for Bubu Pharmacy's business?

dialogues.speaker: Herbalist Gui
dialogues.text: Well, this was my personal wish, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Herbalist Gui
dialogues.text: I put prescriptions together because I do not wish for people to be tormented by illness.

dialogues.speaker: Herbalist Gui
dialogues.text: There's an old saying that sums this up nicely: "Dusty old medicine sat on the shelf, a small price to pay for a world of good health."

dialogues.speaker: Herbalist Gui
dialogues.text: Not to mention that I'd be less busy if everyone remained healthy! That'd be a good thing, in my books...

dialogues.speaker: Herbalist Gui
dialogues.text: ...Oh no! I've suddenly remembered! There's still a customer I haven't delivered medicine to...

dialogues.speaker: Herbalist Gui
dialogues.text: I'm sorry — I have to go! Happy Lantern Rite!

talks.objective: Give a Xiao Lantern to Herbalist Gui

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Where are Baizhu and Qiqi?

dialogues.speaker: Herbalist Gui
dialogues.text: Qiqi went out to gather some herbs and still isn't back yet... It's highly possible that she might have gotten lost somewhere due to her poor memory again...

dialogues.speaker: Herbalist Gui
dialogues.text: As for Dr. Baizhu, I think he's probably doing some medical research or something else of that nature. Either way, it's not my place to ask.

talks.objective: Head to the designated location to look for Herbalist Gui

dialogues.speaker: Herbalist Gui
dialogues.text: Ah, you're here. I've already written my wish on the lantern.

dialogues.speaker: Herbalist Gui
dialogues.text: This is good timing... Let's release this lantern.

dialogues.speaker: Herbalist Gui
dialogues.text: I wonder if we have enough herbs left...

dialogues.speaker: Herbalist Gui
dialogues.text: I'm sorry to trouble you during this festive time, Traveler, but we're a little in over our heads at the moment. The number of people requiring medicine from Bubu Pharmacy always peaks during the Lantern Rite period.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why does that happen...

dialogues.speaker: Herbalist Gui
dialogues.text: During the Lantern Rite, everyone puts their work aside to spend time with their families. Of course, there will be all manner of banquets, with fine food and drink flowing all around...

dialogues.speaker: Herbalist Gui
dialogues.text: Suddenly, everyone's got indigestion, or else they're coming down with some malady or other...

dialogues.speaker: Herbalist Gui
dialogues.text: I'm always encouraging people to not eat too much, but during a food-driven festival like this, my advice tends to fall on deaf ears.

dialogues.speaker: Herbalist Gui
dialogues.text: Just now, a few more customers contacted me, asking if I could bring them some medicine for indigestion and other stomach problems. But I can't simply stop manning the pharmacy...

dialogues.speaker: Herbalist Gui
dialogues.text: Traveler, if it's alright with you, could you help me deliver some medicine?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Isn't there anyone else who can help?

dialogues.speaker: Herbalist Gui
dialogues.text: Well... No one else at the pharmacy is free at the moment...

dialogues.speaker: Herbalist Gui
dialogues.text: Hmm, how many more deliveries of medicine do we need to make...

dialogues.speaker: Guanhai
dialogues.text: Ahh, that's much better... Now, what should I eat later, I wonder?

dialogues.speaker: Herbalist Gui
dialogues.text: What should I wish for...
